title: Diagnose and remediate reachable GO-2026-6809 stdlib trust vulnerability with patched Go 1.26.10
goal: Resolve the observed mandatory CHK-SCA-GO blocker in #195: expose only strictly validated public GO advisory IDs in failure messages, then upgrade all nine existing Go module/toolchain declarations from 1.26.8/1.26.9 to official Go 1.26.10, fixed for crypto/x509 Certificate.Verify (GO-2026-6809), without touching product code or disabling any security control.
invariants: All reachable findings still cause CHK-SCA-GO FAILURE; no suppression, ignore list, baseline, severity downgrade, scanner parameter change or SCA scope reduction
Only public strict ASCII GO-YYYY-NNNN advisory identifiers, maximum four sorted unique labels, may enter error text; every other raw scanner datum stays private
Malformed/missing IDs remain a blocking generic identifier-unavailable error
No product data, Go toolchain version or dependency changed blindly without exact finding

All nine repo Go module go directives use official Go 1.26.10 fixed crypto/x509 stdlib version; all workflows whose setup-go uses go-version-file inherit patched compiler; do not change package APIs, binary logic, runtime authorization or source data.
No claim GO-2026-6809 resolved until exact candidate GitHub SCA and full relevant cross-platform Go workflows pass; no go.sum or dependency version changes unless reproducible tests require them.

No arbitrary waiver of CHK-EVENT-INSPECTION-E2E: permit only exact original/patched go.mod blob pair, no other Event Inspection file path diff, run fresh full module tests and vet, preserve all original 13 adversarial tests and performance checks.
security_properties: Never echo private import/module path, package, receiver, function, source, traces, URLs or arbitrary OSV text
No secrets or report content in CI diagnostics; original SAST and secret scanners remain unchanged

migration.rationale: Engineering CLI diagnostic display only; no product runtime or schema.

rollback.strategy: Restore generic blocked count without weakening SCA
verification: CHK-SCA-GO still fails on reachable finding
